name: pen90_letter_portrait
description: Bare ballpoint refill clamped at 90 deg to the gripper jaws (pointing down, gripper horizontal); US-letter sheet in portrait, its centre ~340 mm in front of the base. Used for the final Petronas Twin Towers drawing (2026-09-16).

surface.source: ink ladders 2026-09-16: lowest inking level ~8 mm at x=270 mm, ~8.5 mm at 325 mm, ~9.5 mm at 370 mm

notes: pen_reference_q is the pose the user left the arm in with the refill tip touching the sheet centre; pen length was auto-estimated from it (tip on z=0).
Commanded paper height is +8.5 mm, not 0: the stretched arm sags ~8-9 mm under gravity at this reach.
Servo-lag probing does not work with the flexible refill (it bends ~9 mm before the servos notice) - use ink ladders.
press 3.0 mm drew light grey lines; 3.5 mm plus a reversed second pass on outlines gave the final line weight.
